function.name: str_replace_editor

content:
ERROR:
Invalid `new_str` parameter:             Token::Slash => Token::Slash,
            '^' => Token::Caret,
            '%' => Token::Percent,
            '?' => Token::Question,
            ',' => Token::Comma,
            ';' => Token::Semicolon,
            '(' => Token::OpenParen,
            ')' => Token::CloseParen,
            _ => return None,
        };
        self.chars.next();
        Some(token)
    }
. No replacement was performed. `new_str` and `old_str` must be different.
